en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Abu Al Jaroud, from Abu Saeed, 
(It has been narrated) from Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> having said:
’The one who wears clothes which defame him, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Clothe him on the Day of Judgement in a garment from the Fire’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from abu al-Jarud from abu Sa‘id who has said the following: “Al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If one wears a dress that causes public abhorrence, Allah on the Day of Judgment will make him to wear a dress of fire.’”
